title: A unified large language model-based framework for heterogeneous PV image diagnosis
mechanism: Task-aware diagnostic prompting of multimodal LLMs (zero- and few-shot) for visible, EL and IR PV images in one pipeline.
evidence: R: GPT-5.1 few-shot > 97.3 % accuracy; zero-shot 83.5 % on full ELPV, 2.8 points under a supervised CNN; open models (Qwen, CLIP) weaker on EL and IR; benchmark set of labelled PV images released.
adaptation: Benchmark: an image-level MLLM baseline (crack present / inactive present per cell) under our fixed split; deliverable: zero-label thermal triage; possible helper for the 24 audit-flagged train cells.
min_experiment: Arm open-weight VLM few-shot crack / inactive presence on F51 val cells; baseline house model image-level max probability; metric AUROC per class; kill as a scorer if AUROC < house minus 0.10 (keep as benchmark row).
